All three games are twitchy FPSes, so what's the difference? Level design. UT is built around fast 3D movement, open spaces and long sight lines; camping will never work there because it makes you an easier target than the people you're trying to camp. CS is built around chokepoints; you'll never win if you don't have somebody AWPing the double doors and someone autosniping the hallways. TF2 is built so that every aspect of the level forces team play; there's no one spot that a sniper can hold singlehandedly, but a sufficiently high value spot warrants the use of three or more players to defeat any combination of attacking classes, in turn requiring the opposing team to launch a focused attack when no one or two players can defeat a given defensive position.
